date.as_written: khapañcaturagadvijādhipasame śake māsake śucau sitadale tithau śivamite budhe śakrabhe

notes: Chronogram: kha (0) + pañca (5) + turaga (7) + dvijādhipa (1) = Śaka 1750. Month śuci = Āṣāḍha; tithi śivamita = 11; śakrabha = Jyeṣṭhā. The place may refer to Kāśī/Vārāṇasī (acalasuteśituḥ pure, 'in the city of the lord of Pārvatī'). The scribe's name may be Vibudhalāla Ratnanidhi Śarman, or Ratnanidhi Śarman described with the epithet vibudha-lāla.
